text:
maya: heads-up: us-east1 dedicated gpu pool (pool-id: ded-e1-42) queue depth spiked to ~600, eviction rate rising. We're auto-failing to hosted now. seeing 95% GPU mem pressure on a few nodes. tagging @sanjay @oncall-mgr
ops-bot: Alert: dedicated-pool-ded-e1-42: GPUUtil>90% for 10m; fallback-triggered -> routing to hosted (weight=0.25 host). IncidentID: INC-2026-045
sanjay: pulling logs, is this after the maintenance window? I see drain events at 19:02 UTC in node e1-17.
maya: yes, we kicked a rolling kernel patch at 18:50 and about 30% of the pool got drained faster than expected. drain backlog + high traffic = queue.
liam: propose rapid weight-swap: reduce dedicated weight to 0 and bump hosted weight to 1 for critical routes, keep canary for low-priority orgs. command:
```
redwoodctl routing set-weight --region us-east1 --pool dedicated:ded-e1-42 0 \
  && redwoodctl routing set-weight --region us-east1 --pool hosted:us-east1 1
```
maya: +1 but prefer gradual: 0.0 -> 0.5 -> 0.0 over 2min to avoid burst cost. start canary at 5% for non-SLA orgs.
elaine: cost note: if hosted takes ~50% sustained extra throughput, estimate ~$12k/day increase. need to notify finance if >24h.
sanjay: running `kubectl get pods -n infra -o wide | grep ded-e1-42` shows 8 evicted pods, 12 pending. attaching sample:
```
NAME                          STATUS     NODE       RESTARTS
inference-worker-7f9d8        Evicted    e1-17
inference-worker-3b2a1        Pending    <none>
```
oncall-mgr: assigning pager to @sanjay, @maya. set incident channel #inc-1904561234
maya: executing gradual weight bump now: switching to 50% hosted for critical routes. monitoring token latencies.
ops-bot: Deploy: routing weights updated by maya at 19:08:30 UTC. Changes: hosted weight 0.5 for route /v1/generate critical
liam: monitor KV cache miss rate — fallback to hosted will lose prefix cache, expect ~8-12% extra token cost. Suggest enabling per-org cache warmup for top orgs.
maya: confirming tail latency improved from 1.8s->1.1s P95. queue depth dropping. cost impact visible in console: spike shows in cost dashboard.
elaine: created finance ticket FIN-628, set alert for >$20k/day delta.
sanjay: nodes draining stabilized, kernel patch completed. I'll start slow pod reschedules and gradually raise dedicated weight when nodes green.
maya: plan: keep hosted at 50% for next 15m, then re-evaluate. filing postmortem blockers: auto-drain rate limit missing + insufficient pre-warm.
liam: noted. adding TODO: default canary for maintenance should be 10% by default.
oncall-mgr: marked resolved on-call shift at 19:12 UTC. follow-up: schedule postmortem and update runbook.
